name: Misty Shore
summary: Misty Shore is the quiet northern shoreline of Hillsbrad Foothills, skirting the southern edge of Lordamere Lake. Stretching between Dandred's Fold and the perimeter of Dalaran, it offers wide, foggy views of the Dawning Isles and the sinister silhouette of Fenris Keep.

sections.title: A Fog-Shrouded Waterline
sections.body: Running along Lordamere Lake, the Misty Shore stretches between Dandred's Fold and Dalaran. Thick, damp air regularly drifts off the lake, obscuring snapping turtles and the occasional zealous fanatic who wanders down from regional strongholds.

sections.title: Watching the Lake
sections.body: From the banks of the Misty Shore, travelers look out across the waters toward the Dawning Isles and the imposing shadow of Fenris Keep. Because of its vantage point across Lordamere Lake and its proximity to both Dalaran and Scarlet-controlled pockets, travelers along the bank often keep a low profile to avoid unwanted attention.

faq.q: Where is the Misty Shore located?
faq.answer: Misty Shore forms the northern waterline of Hillsbrad Foothills, running along the southern bank of Lordamere Lake between Dandred's Fold and the Dalaran perimeter.

faq.q: What can be seen across the water from here?
faq.answer: Looking north across the waters of Lordamere Lake, you can see the Dawning Isles and the looming structure of Fenris Keep out in the fog.

faq.q: What threats are typically found along the shore?
faq.answer: The shoreline is inhabited by lake beasts like snapjaw turtles, but travelers also risk encountering zealots aligned with the Scarlet Crusade or scouts roaming from neighboring farmsteads and ruins.

angles.text: The shores of Lordamere Lake provide an abundant hunting ground for snapping turtles, yielding tender meat valuable to cooks traveling through Hillsbrad.
The misty bank provides a natural approach between the Forsaken-held lands near Tarren Mill and the northern lakeshore, keeping travelers sheltered from open patrols.
